claude_proposed_widenings.name: shared_magic_item_resource_pool
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Composite magic items currently make each part own its own resource. This staff needs one shared 10-charge pool consumed by both spellcasting and reflection properties and recharged once at dawn.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This staff has 10 charges. ... Cast Spell. You can expend 1 of the staff's charges ... Reflect Enchantment. ... expend 1 charge from the staff ... Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d8 + 2 expended charges daily at dawn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: triggered_nonreaction_magic_item_ability
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a triggered save-outcome property that is not passive and does not consume a Reaction, so it does not fit the existing triggered_reaction non-spell family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. You can't use this property of the staff again until the next dawn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: upgrade_triggering_save_outcome
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No existing effect atom expresses replacing the triggering failed save result with a success.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can turn your failed save into a successful one
